name: Backend PHP & Squads (Symfony / API Platform / 2cloud)
description: Backend engineering standards for 2cloud-services microservices (PHP 8.3+, Symfony, API Platform, Doctrine) and 2cloud (CakePHP) across Popcorn, Pili, Banana, Papaya, and Moneris squads.
